sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of form (W-D-W-W-W), host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager arrive in poor shape, anchored near the bottom with just 4 points and on a five-match losing streak, making this a strong opportunity for the leaders to extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a crucial away trip to Dawley Town, with the title race tightening between the top sides. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third with 19 points despite a recent loss, host Eccleshall in a mid-table contest. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community in a fixture between sides with mixed recent form. Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points and in strong form, are away at Foley Meir. Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a clash between teams in the lower-mid table, while New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a bottom-half encounter. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a match between struggling sides. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's basement club with just 2 points from 7 games and five consecutive defeats.
